frequency_question: What proportion of major contested financial/fee rulemakings reach formal finalization within the standard window?
membership_rule: Federal rules published in the Unified Agenda or proposed rulemaking notices involving significant fee adjustments (>50% increase or novel high-value fees) that face intense public or legal scrutiny.
window: 300 days from initial significant regulatory milestone or notice.

known_gaps: Excludes rules withdrawn early in the interagency review process before public notice.
validity_reason: Administrative Procedure Act timelines and standard executive rulemaking momentum change slowly over multi-year horizons.
